parameters.name: Accessibility
parameters.description:
Visibility of the task. Valid values:

- PUBLIC: Visible to all users in this workspace.

- PRIVATE: Visible only to you and administrators in this workspace.

parameters.name: TensorboardId
parameters.description: Tensorboard ID. For more information about how to get a Tensorboard ID, see [ListTensorboards]().

parameters.name: WorkspaceId
parameters.description: Workspace ID. For more information about how to get a workspace ID, see [ListWorkspaces]().
